title: PageQuery
description:
The query parameters a page reads from its address (`?view=declined&period=this_month`), each by name, declared once with `defineQuery` and read with `readQuery` (`@ouispec/bindings`). The generator reads the declaration where the page, a component it renders or an app hook they call reads it, and the generated `app.navigate` takes it, so the assistant opens the page already filtered to a question, in one call. A page that declares none takes its address as before.

**Every value is a build-time constant**, as a binding's are: a literal, a `const` it can follow (an imported option list too), a property of a constant object, or a template literal or `+` over those.

QueryParam.description: One query parameter: free text, a number, an on/off flag, a day, or one of a list of values.

QueryText.description: Free text: a name as the page shows it, a search.

description.description: What the value picks, for someone who cannot see the screen: what to pass and where it comes from.

default.description: What the page shows when the address leaves it out.

multiple.description: It takes several values, written comma-separated in the address (`?tags=a,b`). A value cannot hold a comma.

QueryNumber.description: A number: a page of a list (`integer`, from 1), a minimum score.

unit.description: The unit the number is in (`%`, `days`, `$`), as `x-unit` names it.

QueryFlag.description: On or off: `1` in the address is on, `0` or nothing is off (unless its default is on).

QueryChoice.description: One of a list of values (a view, a period, a status): the list a select or tabs already show, by value and label.

values.description: Every value the page takes, each a string or `{ value, label, description }`: the same option list its control renders.

default.description: One of `values`: what the page shows when the address leaves it out.

multiple.description: It takes several of the values, comma-separated in the address (`?signals=a,b`).

QueryValue.description: One value of a choice: the value, or the value with what a person calls it and what it means.

label.description: What a person calls it (`Declined work`).

description.description: What it means, when its label does not say.
